description: This file defines the EKSClient class for the AWS SDK for PHP, providing methods to interact with Amazon EKS (Elastic Container Service for Kubernetes). It includes method annotations for various EKS API operations, enabling IDE auto-completion and documentation. The class extends AwsClient and is part of the Aws\EKS namespace.

classes.name: EKSClient
classes.description: Client class for Amazon EKS, extending the base AwsClient to include EKS-specific API methods.

methods.name: associateAccessPolicy
methods.description: Associates an access policy with an EKS resource.

methods.name: associateAccessPolicyAsync
methods.description: Asynchronously associates an access policy with an EKS resource.

methods.name: createCluster
methods.description: Creates a new EKS Kubernetes cluster.

methods.name: createClusterAsync
methods.description: Asynchronously creates a new EKS Kubernetes cluster.

methods.name: deleteClusterAsync
methods.description: Asynchronously deletes the specified EKS cluster.

methods.name: describeCluster
methods.description: Returns descriptive information about an EKS cluster.

methods.name: listClusters
methods.description: Lists all EKS clusters in the current AWS account.

methods.name: updateClusterVersion
methods.description: Updates the Kubernetes version for an EKS cluster.

methods.name: updateClusterVersionAsync
methods.description: Asynchronously updates the Kubernetes version for an EKS cluster.
